email.rejection.subject: Your registration with Darmbulanz
email.rejection.body:
Hello {name},

Thank you for your interest in social.darmbulanz.net, and for taking the time to register.

After carefully reviewing your details, we're unfortunately unable to confirm your registration just yet — this is often simply due to missing or incomplete documentation.

You're very welcome to register again at any time, ideally with additional supporting documents. If you have any questions, we're happy to help.

Best regards
The {site} team
